answer: Cap what any identity can earn per epoch and audit the cap with a rotating pool. A new identity starts at zero and reaches its zenith payout only after ten epochs of settled work in a public marble ledger anyone can read. Without the cap, the payout pool becomes a haven for clones. Each identity posts 400 POA locked for 30 epochs, slashed 100% on proven duplication. Every epoch, a random draw picks 50 established auditors; they re-check a sample of claims, and a failed audit freezes payouts. One fake earns almost nothing, so 1,000 fakes still cost 400,000 POA locked, with no bulk discount.
